pr_title: Request immediate refresh of cursor in 2D editor while using shortcuts
pr_body:
The only place across whole editor, where cursor is updated is in viewport.cpp (line 2288), but it happens only when MouseMotion event is fired.

Issue describes problem, when someone presses the shortcut key to switch between tools - in that case no MouseMotion is performed. 
That's why I've used direct call to DisplayServer to update that cursor immediately. 

![cursor-change](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1110337/77693230-4ae60980-6fa8-11ea-9b7d-7f2427d82698.gif)

Fixes: #37333
pr_comments: Could this fix #30582? I'm not sure if that issue still applies in the current `master` branch though.
@dreamsComeTrue Would you want to make a backport PR for `3.2`? The cherry-pick isn't trivial due to the DisplayServer and Viewport changes in `master`.

issue_context.title: After dragging something in the 2D editor, the cursor shape doesn't change until the cursor is moved
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:** Git https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/584ca0f156cec64c259382895e105cf27566a987

**OS/device including version:** Fedora 30, NVIDIA 430.26

**Issue description:** After finishing a dragging operation in the 2D editor, the mouse cursor shape will only change once the cursor is moved again.

**Steps to reproduce:** Drag a node in the 2D editor, release the left mouse button but don't move the move. The cursor will still use the "dragging" shape until you move it.

**Minimal reproduction project:** N/A (can be reproduced in any project)
comments:
I wasn't able to reproduce the issue.
**Godot version:** [584ca0f](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/584ca0f156cec64c259382895e105cf27566a987)

**OS/device including version:** Windows 10/Razerblade Pro 2014
@sparkart I tested this on Windows and couldn't reproduce it there as well, so I'll assume this issue is Linux-specific.
I can still reproduce this on commit https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/7a62b94bcae4da685144ce11aa6f1c8ad19b7c71 (Fedora 31, GeForce GTX 1080).
#58913 is being reverted temporarily, but let's keep this one closed and treat it as a duplicate of #45936 (same root cause).

review_comments: Shouldn't this be done inside the update_cursor function ?

I didn't want to alter the way how ```_gui_input_viewport``` works - so ```_update_cursor``` it's only simple extraction of cursor selection, and immediate request for refresh is only called in ```_button_tool_select``` then.
OK, I guess it makes sense.
